splits: api sales/sales/sales.controller.ts (lands in sales/assignment): its my-subscriptions routes go to sales/money/views and its my-meetings routes go to teaching/classroom/meetings. The admin assign, rule, history, ownership and scope parts stay in assignment.

api finance/subscriptions/alerts: admin-tasks.controller, repo and tests leave by stem. subscription-alerts.module is split so that admin-tasks gets its own Nest module. alerts.job, repo, service and unpaid-flags stay.
api finance/subscriptions/used-before: the controller and module from sales/sales-money/used-before and the repo and service from used-before-edit are merged into one Nest module.

api common/push (lands in messaging/notifications/push): push.module is split into a push module (dispatch, expo, web, service, token migrations) and a bell module (notifications.controller, repo and mapper, family-readers, the notification-bell migration test), each in its own feature folder.
api messaging/messaging-jobs: the wiring module and index.ts are deleted. family-push's own module is imported where messaging-jobs was.
api messaging/inbox/thread-files.module.ts stays out of the map. It is merged into the files feature's module by hand, because files/ already has 12 code files.
api whatsapp/lines/numbers-health (from numbers/lines): the two line-health checks become one job and one repo.
api teaching/lesson-links: family-link and student-link (from classroom) and join-token resolve the same join-link concept. Merge them into one token service.
api teaching/classroom/live/room-state (from lessons/live-room) is registered in the live-room module.
api teaching/booking: booking.module drops the teacher-alert providers, which go to notifications/teacher-alert. booking/teacher/tests left after the stem moves goes to slots/tests.
shared messaging/schemas.ts (lands in inbox): the template schemas (threadTemplate, templateStarter, templateHealth, templateLine) go to messaging/templates. The thread text and file schemas stay.

shared messaging/wa.ts (lands in whatsapp): send retry and errors stay. The session window goes to inbox/send and waIdToE164 goes to webhook. The generic backoff is deleted in favour of @ab/core async/retry, which is already a dependency (a deletion, not a move).
shared people/students/schemas/people.ts: the guardian schemas go to people/guardians and the teacher schemas to people/teachers. The student schemas stay. The old schemas index.ts barrel is removed.
shared sales/assignment/views.ts: leadAssignSchema stays. The salesperson's subscription and meeting views go to sales/money.
shared schemas/index.ts and schemas.test.ts: the barrel is deleted, src/index.ts exports each feature, and schemas.test is split per feature.
shared messaging/notifications/bell/index.ts (the old notifications barrel): it keeps only the bell exports. messaging/index.ts re-exports each notifications feature.
shared sales/students/package-cancel.ts duplicates CancelBlock in @ab/money ledger/usage. The copy is deleted and importers use @ab/money.
client-core finance/subscriptions/list-filters: SessionFilter goes to teacher-earnings and SubscriptionFilter stays.
client-core people/roster/index.ts re-exports only, so it is deleted. core/errors keeps index.ts and errors.test.ts once its two files leave; fold them into core/http.
client-core messaging/inbox/search: a new index.ts re-exports chat-search and message-search (map barrels).

staff-web finance/finance api.ts, search.ts, index.ts and its two tests (land in invoices): invoicesQuery stays in invoices, receivablesQuery goes to receivables, and the summary query goes to reporting/dashboard/finance-summary. No finance/finance folder is left.

staff-web finance, messaging, people, platform, reporting and sales /keys: each key factory goes to its feature as x.keys.ts, or to client-core when web and mobile both read it. The six folders are then deleted.
staff-web sales/sales leftovers (api.ts, ViewHead, search, use-sales-unread, SalesLists and SalesViews tests, land in sales/students): each file goes to the feature that imports it.
staff-web teaching/courses/course-change/api.ts (from course-actions): the stop calls go to course-stop.
staff-web sales/money/chat-subscribe (from inbox/sales): SalesFamilyLine goes to sales/leads/family-link if it reads the lead family link.

staff-mobile leftovers (finance/shared, money/shared, ops/shared, sales/sales components, lib and testing, teacher lib, components and screens): each queries file goes to the feature that calls it. MonthPicker, StateNote and SubScreenHeader go to src/core/ui, ascii-digits to src/core/lib, and month helpers stay until an @ab/time follow-up.
staff-mobile core/lib/keys: one x.keys.ts per feature, then the folder is deleted.
staff-mobile teaching/courses/course-change/course-actions-api.ts (from students/course-actions): the stop calls go to course-stop.
staff-mobile app/_layout.tsx: GatedRoot and its effect go to src/shell/root-gate. app/login.tsx: its mode state goes to features/people/sign-in/pages/LoginScreen. Both route files keep one import.
family-mobile shell/hrefs.ts and portal/recordings/hrefs.ts: each href goes to the index.ts of the feature it opens, so shell keeps none.
family-web routes (portal, reports, children/index, children/$studentId, package): the WithHome and WithPick render-prop wrappers move into the pages, so each route maps a URL to one page.
